cpu_model: dual LSU agents; not a retired-instruction CPU model
memory_model: writable 64-byte line model; response delay is configurable

metric_definitions.amat: mean accepted CPU request-to-response cycles, by read/write and L1 hit/miss class
metric_definitions.bandwidth: accepted 64-bit line-memory beats times eight bytes divided by measured window cycles
metric_definitions.fairness: Jain index over per-core completion counts during the window
metric_definitions.l1_hit_miss: accepted CPU requests classified by L1 event pins; write hits exclude S-to-M permission upgrades
metric_definitions.l2_refill_hit_miss: accepted Directory refill lookup events, not all L2 tag probes
metric_definitions.miss_penalty: mean L1-miss response latency minus mean L1-hit response latency
metric_definitions.mshr_occupancy: per-cycle popcount of exported refill-MSHR valid bits; Directory context occupancy is reported separately
metric_definitions.parallel_speedup: same 16 cold cache lines and memory delay: single-core serial cycles divided by dual-core paired cycles
metric_definitions.stall_cycles: cycles of VALID without READY, reported by channel and core; categories may overlap
metric_definitions.throughput: completed CPU requests divided by measured window cycles, per core and aggregate

result_interpretation: RTL simulation cycles and modeled memory traffic; not silicon PPA, real CPU IPC/CPI, or physical DRAM bandwidth
